title: ECHO: Replacing the Compliance Proxy with Response Harmfulness in Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attack
abstract: arXiv:2610.23030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite extensive safety alignment, large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing optimization-based attacks share a single objective: maximize a token-level proxy of victim compliance---such as the likelihood of an affirmative prefix---computed on the prompt rather than the decoded reply. This proxy cannot distinguish a cautious hedge from a fully actionable harmful answer, leaving the search blind to what the model actually says. We propose ECHO (Evaluation-Conditioned Harmfulness Optimization), which replaces the compliance proxy with response-level, continuous harmfulness scores from HarmSig, a 1.7B regressor grounded in actual harmful capability. ECHO couples HarmSig with five word-level perturbation operators and Keyword-Anchored Beam Search with global top-m memory, under a strict black-box threat model. Across five open-weight victims on AdvBench, ECHO achieves up to 0.898 StrongREJECT mean score and 89

translated_title: ECHO：在基于优化的越狱攻击中用回复危害性替代合规性代理
translated_abstract: 尽管经过了广泛的安全对齐，大语言模型仍然容易受到越狱攻击。现有的基于优化的攻击共享一个单一目标：最大化受害模型合规性的token级代理指标——例如肯定前缀的可能性——该指标是在提示词上而非解码后的回复上计算的。这种代理指标无法区分谨慎的模糊回应与完全可操作的有害答案，使攻击搜索对模型实际输出的内容视而不见。我们提出ECHO（评估条件化危害性优化），它用来自HarmSig的回复级连续危害性分数替代合规性代理，HarmSig是一个基于实际有害能力的1.7B回归模型。ECHO在严格的黑盒威胁模型下，将HarmSig与五个词级扰动算子以及带有全局top-m记忆的关键词锚定束搜索相结合。在AdvBench上的五个开源权重受害模型上，ECHO实现了高达0.898的StrongREJECT平均分数和89……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: ECHO提出用基于回复实际危害性的连续评分（由1.7B的HarmSig回归模型提供）替代传统的合规性代理指标，并结合词级扰动算子与关键词锚定束搜索，在严格黑盒条件下显著提升了针对大语言模型的越狱攻击效果。
